description: Image Description: The image displays a single, handwritten numeral "7" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style, with a smooth, continuous stroke that begins at the top left and curves downward to the right, forming the upper part of the "7". The line then extends horizontally to the right before descending vertically, creating the characteristic shape of the number. The stroke appears slightly thick and uneven in width, suggesting it was drawn with a pen or marker.
